plugins.name: stratos-memory-stack
plugins.description: Memory that learns and keeps itself current. Six-layer memory stack (claude-mem, basic-memory, Obsidian, Pinecone, CLAUDE.md/MEMORY.md, STATE.md) plus a nightly learning loop: a capture hook, recurrence-gated consolidation, cross-department scouts that find new tools, and a conductor that ranks them into a daily board. Optional Mode Activators hook for multi-stream vaults. Auto-audits and guides install.
